items.title: A quasi-compact space with a closed point whose complement is quasi-compact
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement describes a quasi-compact space which admits a closed point whose complement is quasi-compact, together with the standing hypothesis making this available (author lemma at source lines 1984-1993, label lemma-quasi-compact-closed-point). The proof (source lines 1995-2012) produces a closed point by choosing a minimal nonempty closed subset and records the counterexample showing the extra hypothesis is necessary (proof lines 1995-2011). The minimal-closed-subset argument and the counterexample are the content. H3.
